description: Traefik access log analysis. The Status Class variable narrows headline stats, top tables, and the access log panel; 5xx Hotspots and breakdown panels stay scoped to their fixed semantics.

panels.description: Every request Traefik accepted in the selected time range, whatever the outcome - including 4xx rejections and status 0 (client hung up before a response). This is the 'how many attempts were made' number and it deliberately ignores the Status Class filter.
panels.title: Requests Attempted

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="traefik-system", container="traefik"} | json | RouterName !~ `httproute-$nsHide-.*` | DownstreamStatus != "" [$__range]))

panels.description: Distinct client IPs (ClientHost) that made at least one request in the range, whatever the outcome. Behind a proxy or NAT this counts source addresses, not people - treat it as a floor on distinct users. Ignores the Status Class filter.
panels.title: Unique Clients

targets.expr: count(sum by(ClientHost) (count_over_time({namespace="traefik-system", container="traefik"} | json | RouterName !~ `httproute-$nsHide-.*` | ClientHost != "" [$__range])))

panels.title: Refused (401/403)
panels.description: Requests rejected as unauthenticated (401) or forbidden (403). A rising count is either a broken client or someone probing. Ignores the Status Class filter.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="traefik-system", container="traefik"} | json | RouterName !~ `httproute-$nsHide-.*` | DownstreamStatus =~ `401|403` [$__range]))

panels.description: Per-second request rate over the auto-step interval, narrowed by the Status Class variable.
panels.title: Request Rate

targets.expr: sum(rate({namespace="traefik-system", container="traefik"} | json | RouterName !~ `httproute-$nsHide-.*` | DownstreamStatus != "" | DownstreamStatus =~ `$status` [$__interval]))

panels.description: Fraction of responses with a 5xx DownstreamStatus. This stat ignores the Status Class variable — it always reports 5xx ÷ all so the error signal is preserved.
panels.title: 5xx Error Rate

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="traefik-system", container="traefik"} | json | RouterName !~ `httproute-$nsHide-.*` | DownstreamStatus != "" | DownstreamStatus =~ `5..` [$__range])) / sum(count_over_time({namespace="traefik-system", container="traefik"} | json | RouterName !~ `httproute-$nsHide-.*` | DownstreamStatus != "" [$__range]))

panels.description: 95th-percentile request duration across the range. Avg / P50 / P99 are plotted over time in the Latency row rather than flattened to a tile.
panels.title: P95 Duration

targets.expr: avg(quantile_over_time(0.95, {namespace="traefik-system", container="traefik"} | json | RouterName !~ `httproute-$nsHide-.*` | DownstreamStatus != "" | DownstreamStatus =~ `$status` | unwrap Duration [$__range])) / 1000000

panels.title: Unique Clients over time
panels.description: Distinct client IPs seen per interval. A step change here separates 'more traffic from the same users' from 'more users' - the request-rate panel alone cannot.

targets.expr: count(sum by(ClientHost) (count_over_time({namespace="traefik-system", container="traefik"} | json | RouterName !~ `httproute-$nsHide-.*` | ClientHost != "" [$__interval])))

panels.title: Refused Attempts by Router (401/403/404)
panels.description: Rejected requests per interval, split by router. Distinguishes a single misconfigured client from a broad scan across routes.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by(RouterName) (count_over_time({namespace="traefik-system", container="traefik"} | json | RouterName !~ `httproute-$nsHide-.*` | DownstreamStatus =~ `401|403|404` [$__interval])))

panels.title: Top 20 Clients by Requests
panels.description: Client IPs ranked by request count over the range, with how many of those were refused. A client whose refused count approaches its total is worth a look.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by(ClientHost) (count_over_time({namespace="traefik-system", container="traefik"} | json | RouterName !~ `httproute-$nsHide-.*` | ClientHost != "" [$__range])))
sum by(ClientHost) (count_over_time({namespace="traefik-system", container="traefik"} | json | RouterName !~ `httproute-$nsHide-.*` | ClientHost != "" | DownstreamStatus =~ `401|403|404` [$__range]))

options.content:
### Access & Volume

| Stat | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| **Requests Attempted** | Every access log line in the range, whatever the outcome — 2xx, 4xx rejections and status 0 alike. Deliberately ignores the Status Class filter, because "how many attempts were made" must not move when you change the filter. |
| **Unique Clients** | Distinct `ClientHost` (source IP) that made at least one request. Behind NAT, a corporate proxy or a CDN this counts source addresses, not people — read it as a **floor** on distinct users, never an exact user count. Also ignores Status Class. |
| **Refused (401/403)** | Requests rejected as unauthenticated or forbidden. Ignores Status Class. |
| **Request Rate** | `req/s` averaged over auto-step, narrowed by Status Class. |
| **5xx Error Rate** | Always `5xx ÷ total`, regardless of Status Class. Orange ≥ 1%, red ≥ 5%. Mixes upstream 5xx with Traefik-internal 5xx (e.g. 503 with `OriginStatus=0` when no backend is available). |
| **P95 Duration** | 95th percentile of Traefik's `Duration` field (ms). Avg / P50 / P99 are plotted over time in the **Latency** row rather than flattened into tiles. |

### Status class quick reference

- **2xx** — success.
- **3xx** — redirect (often expected; e.g. auth flows).
- **4xx** — client error. Almost always a caller-side issue.
- **5xx** — server error. Triage in the **5xx Hotspots** row. A 503 with `OriginStatus=0` and missing `ServiceName` means Traefik couldn't reach a ready backend at all (no Endpoints, NetworkPolicy block, DNS failure, etc.).
- **0** — no response was written: the client disconnected mid-request, or the connection was a long-lived upgrade (WebSocket) that was torn down. Counted in **Requests Attempted** and shown in the traffic breakdowns so the distribution accounts for every request.

### Gotcha: LogQL regexes are fully anchored

`DownstreamStatus =~ `..`` matches a **two**-character value, so it never matches a
three-digit status code. Every regex in this dashboard — Status Class and the Service
textbox alike — must match the whole value: use `.+` for "anything", and
`.*standingdata.*` rather than `.*standingdata`.

panels.description: Per-second request rate split by status class. This panel ignores the Status Class variable — its purpose is the breakdown.
panels.title: Request Rate by Status Class

targets.expr: sum(rate({namespace="traefik-system", container="traefik"} | json | RouterName !~ `httproute-$nsHide-.*` | DownstreamStatus != "" | DownstreamStatus =~ `2..` [$__interval]))
sum(rate({namespace="traefik-system", container="traefik"} | json | RouterName !~ `httproute-$nsHide-.*` | DownstreamStatus != "" | DownstreamStatus =~ `3..` [$__interval]))
sum(rate({namespace="traefik-system", container="traefik"} | json | RouterName !~ `httproute-$nsHide-.*` | DownstreamStatus != "" | DownstreamStatus =~ `4..` [$__interval]))
sum(rate({namespace="traefik-system", container="traefik"} | json | RouterName !~ `httproute-$nsHide-.*` | DownstreamStatus != "" | DownstreamStatus =~ `5..` [$__interval]))
sum(rate({namespace="traefik-system", container="traefik"} | json | RouterName !~ `httproute-$nsHide-.*` | DownstreamStatus = `0` [$__interval]))

panels.description: Share of requests by status class over the range. Includes status 0 - Traefik's code for a client that disconnected before a response was written - so the slices account for every request.
panels.title: Status Code Distribution

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="traefik-system", container="traefik"} | json | RouterName !~ `httproute-$nsHide-.*` | DownstreamStatus != "" | DownstreamStatus =~ `2..` [$__range]))
sum(count_over_time({namespace="traefik-system", container="traefik"} | json | RouterName !~ `httproute-$nsHide-.*` | DownstreamStatus != "" | DownstreamStatus =~ `3..` [$__range]))
sum(count_over_time({namespace="traefik-system", container="traefik"} | json | RouterName !~ `httproute-$nsHide-.*` | DownstreamStatus != "" | DownstreamStatus =~ `4..` [$__range]))
sum(count_over_time({namespace="traefik-system", container="traefik"} | json | RouterName !~ `httproute-$nsHide-.*` | DownstreamStatus != "" | DownstreamStatus =~ `5..` [$__range]))
sum(count_over_time({namespace="traefik-system", container="traefik"} | json | RouterName !~ `httproute-$nsHide-.*` | DownstreamStatus = `0` [$__range]))

panels.description: Top 10 backend services returning 5xx in the selected range. ServiceName has its `@kubernetesgateway` suffix trimmed for readability. Ignores the Status Class variable — always 5xx.
panels.title: Top 10 Services with 5xx

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by(svc) (count_over_time({namespace="traefik-system", container="traefik"} | json | RouterName !~ `httproute-$nsHide-.*` | DownstreamStatus =~ `5..` | ServiceName != "" | label_format svc=`{{ trimSuffix "@kubernetesgateway" .ServiceName }}` [$__range])))

panels.description: Top 10 (Router, Path) returning 5xx. Path has query parameters stripped so /foo?bar=1 and /foo?bar=2 collapse to /foo.
panels.title: Top 10 Paths with 5xx

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by(RouterName, pathClean) (count_over_time({namespace="traefik-system", container="traefik"} | json | RouterName !~ `httproute-$nsHide-.*` | DownstreamStatus =~ `5..` | RequestPath != "" | label_format pathClean=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*" .RequestPath "" }}` [$__range])))

panels.description: Top 10 Traefik Routers (HTTPRoute attachments) by request count, narrowed by Status Class. Aggregating by RouterName instead of RequestPath keeps cardinality bounded.
panels.title: Top 10 Routers

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by(RouterName) (count_over_time({namespace="traefik-system", container="traefik"} | json | RouterName !~ `httproute-$nsHide-.*` | DownstreamStatus != "" | DownstreamStatus =~ `$status` | RouterName != "" [$__range])))

panels.description: Top 10 backend services by request count, narrowed by Status Class. ServiceName has the `@kubernetesgateway` suffix trimmed.
panels.title: Top 10 Backend Services

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by(svc) (count_over_time({namespace="traefik-system", container="traefik"} | json | RouterName !~ `httproute-$nsHide-.*` | DownstreamStatus != "" | DownstreamStatus =~ `$status` | ServiceName != "" | label_format svc=`{{ trimSuffix "@kubernetesgateway" .ServiceName }}` [$__range])))

panels.description: Aggregate latency over time, narrowed by Status Class. p99 is the most useful tail-latency signal.
panels.title: Request Duration Percentiles

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time({namespace="traefik-system", container="traefik"} | json | RouterName !~ `httproute-$nsHide-.*` | DownstreamStatus != "" | DownstreamStatus =~ `$status` | unwrap Duration [$__interval])) / 1000000

avg(quantile_over_time(0.50, {namespace="traefik-system", container="traefik"} | json | RouterName !~ `httproute-$nsHide-.*` | DownstreamStatus != "" | DownstreamStatus =~ `$status` | unwrap Duration [$__interval])) / 1000000

avg(quantile_over_time(0.95, {namespace="traefik-system", container="traefik"} | json | RouterName !~ `httproute-$nsHide-.*` | DownstreamStatus != "" | DownstreamStatus =~ `$status` | unwrap Duration [$__interval])) / 1000000

avg(quantile_over_time(0.99, {namespace="traefik-system", container="traefik"} | json | RouterName !~ `httproute-$nsHide-.*` | DownstreamStatus != "" | DownstreamStatus =~ `$status` | unwrap Duration [$__interval])) / 1000000

panels.description: Average Duration per backend service over time, narrowed by Status Class. ServiceName has the `@kubernetesgateway` suffix trimmed. A flat-then-spiking line for one service typically points to that upstream's saturation, GC pause, or dependency stall.
panels.title: Avg Duration by Service

targets.expr: avg by(svc) (avg_over_time({namespace="traefik-system", container="traefik"} | json | RouterName !~ `httproute-$nsHide-.*` | DownstreamStatus != "" | DownstreamStatus =~ `$status` | ServiceName != "" | label_format svc=`{{ trimSuffix "@kubernetesgateway" .ServiceName }}` | unwrap Duration [$__interval])) / 1000000

panels.description: Top 20 (service, path) pairs by P95 Duration, narrowed by Status Class and Service. ServiceName has `@kubernetesgateway` trimmed; path has query params stripped. Use this to find the specific endpoints driving tail latency.
panels.title: Top 20 (Service, Path) by P95 Latency

targets.expr: topk(20, quantile_over_time(0.95, {namespace="traefik-system", container="traefik"} | json | RouterName !~ `httproute-$nsHide-.*` | DownstreamStatus != "" | DownstreamStatus =~ `$status` | ServiceName != "" | ServiceName =~ `$service` | RequestPath != "" | label_format svc=`{{ trimSuffix "@kubernetesgateway" .ServiceName }}`, pathClean=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*" .RequestPath "" }}` | unwrap Duration [$__range]) by(svc, pathClean)) / 1000000

panels.description: Filtered access log stream. Each line is reformatted as `[status] METHOD host+path → service dur=Xns trace=...` so the route, service, and outcome are visible at a glance. Click a line to expand the full JSON.
panels.title: Traefik Access Logs

targets.expr: {namespace="traefik-system", container="traefik"} | json | RouterName !~ `httproute-$nsHide-.*` | DownstreamStatus != "" | DownstreamStatus =~ `$status` | ServiceName =~ `$service` | line_format `[{{.DownstreamStatus}}] {{.RequestMethod}} {{.RequestHost}}{{.RequestPath}} → {{.ServiceName}} dur={{.Duration}}ns trace={{.TraceId}}`

list.name: status
list.label: Status Class
list.description: Status class applied to most panels (excluding the dedicated breakdowns and 5xx Hotspots). Regexes here are fully anchored by LogQL, so `All` is `.+` rather than `..`. `Aborted (0)` is Traefik's code for a connection the client dropped before a response was written.

list.name: service
list.label: Service
list.description: ServiceName regex applied to the Access Logs and P95 Latency panels. Default `.*` matches every line (including Traefik-internal 503s where ServiceName is empty); override with e.g. `.*grafana.*` to scope to a single backend. NOTE: the regex is fully anchored — `.*standingdata` matches nothing, use `.*standingdata.*`.

list.name: nsHide
list.label: Internal namespaces
list.description: Filter applied to RouterName on every panel. Default hides infra/operator traffic (monitoring, argocd) so the dashboard reflects application traffic. Switch to "Show all" to include them.

title: Traefik Access Logs
